title: Nitrile rubber, preparation method thereof and sealing ring
abstract: The invention provides a nitrile rubber, a preparation method and a sealing ring, belonging to the technical field of composite materials. The nitrile-butadiene rubber provided by the invention comprises the following raw materials by mass: 100 parts of raw nitrile rubber; 0.1-5 parts of liquid nitrile-butadiene rubber modified graphene oxide; 60-90 parts of liquid nitrile-butadiene rubber modified carbon black ; 1 to 3 parts of antioxidant; 2 to 6 parts of compound vulcanizing agent; 1 to 3 parts of accelerator. In the nitrile-butadiene rubber provided by the present invention, the liquid nitrile-butadiene rubber and the nitrile-butadiene rubber raw rubber have similar structures, and the liquid nitrile-butadiene rubber modified graphene oxide and carbon black are used to obtain the obtained liquid nitrile-butadiene rubber modified graphene oxide, liquid nitrile-butadiene rubber Nitrile-butadiene rubber modified carbon black has good compatibility with nitrile-butadiene rubber raw rubber, and liquid nitrile-butadiene rubber can also participate in the vulcanization of nitrile-butadiene rubber. The nitrile rubber provided by the present invention is used to further prepare a sealing ring. The sealing ring has high hardness and tensile strength, low compression set and long service life.
